title: EmailDispatch (harness observation event)
description: Normalized record of one outbound email as captured by the harness SMTP stub (or, on the modern side, the dispatch seam). Emitting sites: legacy ticketd/app/server.py:76 (close) and :94 (reset). Consumed by: verification/replay differ (ED-001..ED-003 assertions).

mode.description: sync = sent inside the request (legacy); queued = handed to the async dispatch path before/independent of the response (modern target under ED-001/ED-002)

body_contains.description: Content assertions, e.g. the ticket title or the placeholder <TOKEN> (raw token values are normalized out by diff rules)
